source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Changing mail.addressDisplayFormat reloads the displayed message. The browser_preferDisplayName test must await messagePaneBrowser after each change before checking rows or finishing. The Bugzilla issue was missing code coverage from windows that had not completed loading; this patch addressed one test path but the bug had already needed another listener cleanup.
title: Wait for message reload after display preference changes
